⚠ ALERT — 2 systems could affect land within 72 hours (ranked by threat to the US / Florida)

🔴 Invest AL92 (Southwestern Gulf of America): formation odds near 100% in 2 days / near 100% in 7 days. If these trends continue, advisories will likely be issued on this system later today or tonight while it moves slowly eastward. The disturbance is expected to turn to the north or northeast toward the northern Gulf Coast by the end of the week. It is still too early to determine specific impacts to the northern Gulf Coast, but interests from the Florida Panhandle to Louisiana should closely monitor the progress of this system.

🟠 Invest EP92 (South of Southern Mexico): formation odds 90% in 2 days / 90% in 7 days. Environmental conditions appear favorable for gradual development, and a tropical depression is likely to form within the next day or so while the system moves slowly west-northwestward to northwestward. Regardless of development, heavy rainfall is expected across portions of southern and southwestern Mexico over the next few days.

US tropical watches/warnings right now: 0 (none anywhere in the US). Next government update: Tue Oct 6, 5:00 PM ET.
